author: mark
text: Open framing question resolved 2026-04-25: no structural framing commit for tool_result blocks. (a) Per-tool steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/tools/<tool-id>/output.json is the on-disk record (single author per file, atomic temp+rename). (b) Wire tool_result blocks are built by the harness at request-assembly time from those files; lives in the harness, not as a structural commit (§4.4 adapter contract already takes fully-framed Anthropic-shape requests on stdin). (c) 'In-progress' is derived state — step N's response.json carries a tool_use block with no matching output.json yet. SSOT-clean. The salvage's 'step N+1's request.json IS the framing commit' framing is rejected: same disk state, but no structural role assigned to that commit. Wire framing belongs in the application layer.
